```{r}
find_best_testset = function(q,u){
	n = length(q)
	if(n != length(u)){ print("ERROR") }
	score = 0
	B = NULL
	for(i in 1:(2^n-1)){
		S = which(intToBits(i)==1)
		if(prod(q[S])*sum(u[S])>score){
			B = S
			score = prod(q[S])*sum(u[S])
		}
	}
	#return(score) #Could also return B
	return(B)
}



#Greedily merge or drop things
greedy_loss = function(q,u){
	n = length(q) #assume q and u are same length
	if(n==1){return(q*u)}
	k = which(q*u==min(q*u))[1] #Find best single item to drop
	l = min(q*u) #loss from dropping this item
	for(i in 1:(n-1)){
		for(j in (i+1):n){
			if(q[i]*u[i]*(1-q[j])+q[j]*u[j]*(1-q[i])<l){
				k = c(i,j)
				l = q[i]*u[i]*(1-q[j])+q[j]*u[j]*(1-q[i])
			}
		}
	}
	if(length(k)==1){
		#print(paste("removing",k))
		return(c(l,greedy_loss(q[-k],u[-k])))
	} else {
		i = k[1]
		j = k[2]
		#print(paste("combining",i,"and",j))
		q[i] = q[i]*q[j]
		u[i] = u[i]+u[j]
		q = q[-j]
		u = u[-j]
		return(c(l,greedy_loss(q,u)))
	}
}


greedy_index = function(q,u){
	n = length(q)
	index = q*u/(1-q)
	high_to_low = rev(order(index))
	size = sum(cumsum(c(0,u[high_to_low[-n]])) < index[high_to_low])
	return(sum(u[high_to_low[1:size]])*prod(q[high_to_low[1:size]]))
}


n = 3
numT = 1000000
min_r = 1
for(t in 1:numT){
	q = runif(n)
	u = runif(n)
	#gl = greedy_loss(q,u)
	gi = greedy_index(q,u)
	b1 = find_best_testset(q,u)
	#if(!all(order(gl) == (1:n))){
	#	print("greedy_loss is not monotonically increasing")
	#	print(q)
	#	print(u)
	#}
	#if(gl[n]/b1<min_r){
		#min_r = gl[n]/b1
	if(gi/b1<min_r){
		min_r = gi/b1
		print(paste("worse ratio found:",min_r))
		print(q)
		print(u)
	}
}
```
